{"command": "echo "To kill VS Code (code.exe) from the command line, open a Command Prompt or PowerShell and run:

    taskkill /IM code.exe /F /T

Explanation:
- /IM code.exe   – Target the executable named code.exe.
- /F             – Force termination.
- /T             – Terminate child processes spawned by code.exe.

If you only want to kill a specific instance, first find its PID:

    tasklist /FI "IMAGENAME eq code.exe"

Then kill it by PID:

    taskkill /PID <pid> /F

Alternatively, in PowerShell you can use:

    Stop-Process -Name code -Force

This will close all running VS Code windows.
""}
